admin_forgot_password: If you forgot your login details or password:
admin_forgot_password_hint: Create an empty file named mikanData/reset_password.txt on the server (inside your configured data directory if renamed). It will be deleted automatically, and the initial setup screen will appear on your next access.
hint_demo_login: Log in with the password to enable saving and all features.
err_media_gif_no_resize: gif cannot be resized, because the animation would be lost.
memo_hint: Feel free to enter notes or reminders here.
label_raw_html: Raw HTML (disable Markdown — use for complex HTML layouts)
page_js_hint: Write code without script tags. Runs after the HTML above, following component JavaScript.
component_js_hint: Write code without script tags. Even when the same component appears multiple times on a page, its JavaScript is initially executed only once. Event handlers, such as click handlers, run each time the event occurs. Also, CSS scoping does not apply to JavaScript.
component_js_embed_hint: Adding a component also loads its JavaScript automatically. To load only the JavaScript, use the following markup.
component_js_path_hint: The installation path is completed automatically. The full JavaScript-only URL is shown below.
label_scope_css: Scope CSS (Prevent leaking to other parts)
use_wrapper_hint: Use for components that define the overall page layout. Include {{CONTENT}} to specify where the page body will be inserted.
hint_site_id: An immutable ID generated for this site so AI can distinguish it from other connected sites.
hint_site_url: Identifies the target site to AI. Leave blank to use the index page location. Override only to identify another public URL; this does not change SSG output or deployment.
hint_site_environment: Identifies production, staging, development or local use to AI, helping it decide where test changes belong. This label does not automatically restrict operations or access.
page_id_hint: The ID used for the page URL. Alphanumeric characters and hyphens allowed.
component_id_hint: Identification for the component. Alphanumeric characters and underscores allowed. A leading _ marks a standard component. Omit it for ordinary new or duplicated components; use it when standard classification is intended.
category_select_hint: Category options can be set in "Design" -> "Site Settings: Category".
use_scope_hint: Recommended to be ON. Prevents CSS from affecting other parts of the site.
media_code_hint: JS/CSS must be UTF-8 and up to 10 MB. Upload only trusted files.
err_media_extension_change: Renaming cannot change the file extension.
sett_password_hint: (Fill only if you want to change)
sett_cat_hint: Category options can be set in "Design" menu -> "Site Settings: Category".
nav_links_cards_hint: NAV_LINKS and NAV_CARDS show all pages if category is 'all', or pages without a category if left empty. Order follows page sort order. Pages with sort order below 0 are hidden.
backup_hint: Download and backup all site data (SQLite file / JSON ZIP) or uploaded media files. You can also import data from external sources.
confirm_system_update:
Update mikanBox to %s?
The current version will be saved for restoration.
confirm_system_reinstall:
The program files for the same version (%s) will be installed again.
Your settings and content are not changed. The current files are kept for restoring.
update_error_download_failed: The update files could not be downloaded from GitHub.
update_error_zip_unavailable: This server cannot extract ZIP files, so the update cannot continue.
update_error_archive_invalid: The contents of the update package could not be verified.
update_error_no_update: This is already the latest version.
update_error_backup_failed: The current program files could not be backed up.
update_error_install_failed: The update failed, so the previous program files were restored.
update_error_core_dir_write_failed: The update was cancelled because the core folder name could not be written into index.php.
update_error_restore_missing: There is no backup available to restore.
update_error_restore_stale: This backup cannot be restored because it was not created for the current version.
update_error_restore_failed: The program files could not be restored from the backup.
update_error_internal: An unexpected error occurred during the update.

msg_media_optimize_skipped: File '%s' uploaded (image too large, automatic processing skipped).
mcp_key_hint: API key for administration MCP connections using MCP 2026-07-28 or the compatible 2025 handshake. Use a client that can set Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key headers. Do not enter this key as an OAuth Client ID or Client Secret.
err_password_chars: Password must be at least 4 characters.
err_csrf: Invalid CSRF token. Please try again.
err_resize_failed: Error: Resize failed (GD not supported or invalid file).

sett_cat_readonly_hint: Categories are freely set on each page. Currently used categories are shown here automatically.
ssg_hint: Exports the site as HTML files. Can be published as a fast and secure static site.

csv_hint: Converts CSV data into a database format usable within your site. The first row is used as field names — use alphanumeric characters only (case-sensitive). Copy the result and paste it into the page body.
msg_demo_mode: Saving is disabled in demo mode.
md_html_mix_short: Markdown and HTML can be mixed.
md_html_block_intro: Lines starting with the following HTML tags are treated as HTML code.

md_list_space_note: A space after the symbol is required for the above.
md_quote_space_note: A space after the symbol is optional.
md_table_row2_required: The second row (separator) is required for table formatting.

hint_data_ascii_rule: key and rowID must be alphanumeric + underscore only. Values can be any text.

device_setup_intro: Register this device as the first admin device. There is no password; this browser becomes the key.
device_label_name: Name for this device (e.g. Work laptop)
device_unregistered_intro: This device is not registered. Issue a code on a registered device (Site → Devices and users) and enter it here.
device_recovery_intro: Write a new token to setup-token.txt in the setup-token folder and upload it first. Every registered device stops, and unused codes and the MCP key are cleared.
device_token_weak: The token in setup-token.txt (in the setup-token folder) is too short or too repetitive. Use a random string of at least %d characters.
device_token_used: The token in setup-token.txt (in the setup-token folder) has already been used. Write a new value.
err_setup_token_invalid: Check the setup token. A used token does not work.
err_device_code_invalid: Check the code. Expired or used codes do not work.
err_device_probation: A device added within %d days cannot stop other devices.
err_device_name_required: Enter a name for this device.
msg_device_code_issued: A device code was issued. It is shown at the top of this section.
device_new_notice: New device(s) registered: %s. If you do not recognize them, stop them in Devices and users below.
device_section_intro: Only registered devices can open the admin screen. There are no passwords. Keeping devices safe is your responsibility; stop a lost device here from another device.
device_probation_notice: This device was added less than %d days ago and cannot stop other devices.
device_confirm_stop_self: Stop this device? You will need a device code to use it again.
device_add_intro: Issue a code, then open the admin screen on the new device and enter it. That device is registered as the same user as you. The code is valid for 3 hours and works once. Keep it private.
device_recovery_note: If every device is lost, write a new token to setup-token.txt in the setup-token folder, upload it, and use Recovery on the sign-in screen. All devices, unused codes and the MCP key are cleared.
device_code_panel_note: This code is shown only now. It is valid for %d hours and works once. Keep it private.
msg_device_adopted: Passwords are gone. The browser you were signed in with before the update is now registered as the first device. Add other devices with a code from Devices and users.
device_password_ended: This site no longer uses passwords (device authentication). You cannot sign in with a password; only registered devices can open the admin screen.
device_invite_admin_intro: Hand over the invite code. The invited person chooses their own user ID and display name when they first sign in. The code is valid for 3 hours and works once.
device_invite_intro: You have been invited. Choose the user ID and display name you will use on this site.
package_layout_title: How to arrange files in the ZIP
package_layout_intro: Place page JSON files in posts/ and component JSON files in components/. Folders under posts/ become part of the page ID.
package_layout_notes: A ZIP may contain an outer folder, for example theme/posts/menu.json. The outer theme folder is not part of the ID, so the page ID is menu. Existing IDs are skipped; settings and images are not imported. Upload images separately in Media.
mcp_enable_hint: Disabling rejects HTTP and local management MCP requests. Public help remains available. The key is retained.
mcp_last_used_label: Current key last used (recorded at most hourly)
audit_hint: Shows the latest 50 events. IP addresses are masked; oldest entries are removed above approximately 1 MB.
audit_unavailable: Security activity could not be recorded. Check data-directory permissions.
